source_text.body:
Let an AI agent read and draft replies in your inbox
An author ran an agent on his professional inbox for a week to read, draft and send email in his voice; it guessed wrongly on one reply, so he kept it in draft mode.
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
The author gave an agent a one-line instruction to reply in his voice, and it invented prices and services. He then fed it about 180 past emails and a business context document. He split the work into categorizing each email and then acting on its category. He added a rule that complaints, disputes and contract questions get flagged for a human instead of drafted.
How it went
By day seven the agent handled 62 emails, 59 of them approved unedited, with review down to 12 minutes. Day-one drafts had invented facts about half the time. Three emails went to the human list.
Worth knowing
Write the escalation rule before day one and stay in draft mode for at least 10 days. A complaint email got a draft on day three because no rule existed yet.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Cowork
Copy prompt
Go through my inbox for [email account] over the last [number] days and read every message that needs a reply. For each one, write a draft reply in my voice, using my past sent emails as a guide, and save it as a draft only. Do not send anything; when you are finished, give me a list of the drafts and flag any where you had to guess at facts, dates or commitments.
Original source: https://www.aidoers.io/blog/ai-agent-email-inbox-week-experiment-electrician
